text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho—the Classic Triple
Crown race
said to be won only by the
strongest
Umamusume—is finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I endorse her skills before trying to send
her off
to the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she responds that the strength
of our
bond is more important than her
skill.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Intent on proving this, she heads to the

racecourse with an invigorated look, as if
freed
from the shackles that once held
her back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
